dataset.age_provenance: Root supplement from deleted speakers.csv at the same official format-conversion commit; no audio-based inference
dataset.population_limit: Only two anonymous test speakers, author historical annotations24/25; one speaker per age cannot establish age effects. No child, present-day age/gender or general population claim; the full-corpus19-30 range is not this test's coverage.

reference_partition.rule: Literal [UNK], case-insensitive, in the original reference only
reference_partition.primary_scores: Corpus-weighted CER/MER_project_v1 and original-language=en WER on the fixed complete-reference population, always with coverage and failures. No-marker does not guarantee perfect annotation.
reference_partition.uncertain_scores: All36 rows retain original references, hypotheses and terminal status separately. Optional full1315 literal distances are diagnostics, not wholly verifiable accuracy.

normalization.table: Exact90 distinct codepoints extracted from author utils.py at8c50c2e2c65f8555eb1d7655310dd585dc1f6710
normalization.source_audit: All1315 reference strings contain zero ignored characters; ASCII square brackets, straight apostrophes and hyphens remain. No traditional/simplified, Unicode NFKC, number/word or synonym rewrite.
normalization.not_author_score_reproduction: Author labels pass through a model tokenizer and jieba MER; project raw-text symmetric normalization and deterministic ASCII-word/CJK-codepoint MER differ. No author-jieba or paper-score label is permitted.

model.name: sherpa-onnx-streaming-zipformer-bilingual-zh-en-2023-02-20
model.assets: Reuse stage_asr fixed four model hashes and three service scripts; exact staged asset/source manifests required
model.runtime_environment: Existing runtime/speech-lab/.venv; no install or changes
model.language_hint: auto for every row, no reference/source-language text is sent
model.warmup: Existing managed service synthetic one-second silence warmup once per fresh phase instance
model.final_right_context: Existing recognizer.finish appends9600 zero samples (600ms of model right context) before input_finished; not source silence or a600ms wall-clock wait.

input.source_pcm_transform: none; no resampling, float roundtrip, gain, trim, transcript-guided edit or quiet-tail addition
input.actual_media_duration_uses: verified PCM sample count, not float duration metadata

execution_scope: Windows ignored Rust diagnostic using the production AsrClient, response/identity/revision validator and new OwnedAsrService. Direct sequential authenticated HTTP streaming; no CaptureStream resampling/800ms queue, physical capture, VAD, Workstation/UI polling, TTS, camera or PTZ acceptance.

phases.pacing: no media-clock sleep; await each20ms chunk response before sending next
phases.scope: warm service/client full-file throughput and transcript quality, not realtime latency

phases.order: unchanged metadata-selected realtime-subset-draft IDs/order, frozen into prepared subset
phases.pacing: submit each20ms chunk only when its last sample would be available on the media clock; sequential response backpressure may delay later chunks
phases.scope: small paced service/client replay;12 samples are not a population P95 guarantee

phase_ownership: Each explicitly invoked phase gets one new owned service/UUID/token on an ephemeral loopback port. No automatic restart, attach, public descriptor,18867 access or global process kill. New service preparation timing is recorded separately; OS cache is not reset.

failure_policy.valid_empty_final: Successful empty hypothesis, kept and scored as deletions; no replacement or fallback
failure_policy.failed_row: Keep finite failure code, last partial separately and empty final hypothesis for pipeline scoring
failure_policy.after_failure: Always attempt only exact UUID/generation cancellation. Stop this phase on any request/protocol/timeout/instance failure, mark remaining declared rows not_run; do not poison or reset the managed client then continue
failure_policy.abrupt_process_or_systemic_abort: Scorer synthesizes missing output statuses against frozen full denominator without modifying raw records; incomplete run cannot claim complete-model accuracy
failure_policy.phase_repeat_rule: Realtime12 is a separately predeclared phase, not a retry or replacement for accuracy outputs; never use its hypotheses to fill accuracy failures

realtime_reports: first partial minus first PCM request
EOF final request to final receipt
last PCM request to final receipt
timing.limits: EOF is not physical button release. Presegmented files do not test long-thinking pauses or acoustic endpoint detection. Partial receipt is not UI subtitle presentation. Fast-phase times are not realtime claims.

cleanup: Always await OwnedAsrService.stop and retain exact instance, child/interpreter exit, launcher/interpreter empty Jobs and cleanup_confirmed. Forced cleanup remains explicitly marked; warm/closed/http_closed alone does not pass.
paraformer_comparison: Pending a separately declared same-input comparison; this first Zipformer baseline does not complete model selection or broader bilingual/age requirements.
